rules.semantic: In a scripted match the level's damage gate decides a turn: a cancel spares the victim; a replacement below the victim's hp is ordinary damage (hp drops by it, a positive amount stamps the attacker's chain head, the victim retaliates) and never a kill; a replacement at or above hp destroys and credits the chain head (a charmed caster heads its own chain with fixes on).
